name: Tigecycline
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 100 mg IV loading dose, then 50 mg every 12 hours (infuse over 30 to 60 minutes)

key_interactions.effect: Higher calcineurin inhibitor levels; toxicity risk (label).

contraindications: Known hypersensitivity to tigecycline or excipients
